patterns: Gainer/loser one-liners are the APPSC staple: inflation hurts creditors, benefits debtors; purchasing power of money decreases.
'Which index measures inflation' recurs; older APPSC keys say WPI (pre-2014), newer ones CPI-Combined as headline - watch the year of the paper.
Definitions: headline vs core (core excludes food and fuel), deflation vs disinflation, demand-pull causes, bottleneck/stagflation.
Publisher pairs: CPI-IW = Labour Bureau (used for DA), WPI = Office of Economic Adviser/Ministry of Commerce; WPI manufactured weight ~64%.
App adds many 2026 data-point MCQs (monthly CPI prints, AP inflation, RBI Act sections) far beyond PYQ depth, which are simple and definitional.
